description: Recommends how much moving help a job needs (suggested labor hours and crew size) for the load and unload locations, based on the size of the move. You MUST provide at least one of squareFeet or linearFeet to describe the size of the goods -- a call with neither is rejected. Also provide flights of stairs at each location. Optionally include counts of heavy items, which increase the recommended crew and hours.

heavyItems300To450Qty.description: Number of heavy items weighing between 300 and 450 lbs

heavyItems450To600Qty.description: Number of heavy items weighing between 450 and 600 lbs

heavyItems600PlusQty.description: Number of heavy items weighing over 600 lbs

linearFeet.description: The linear feet (LFT) of the goods to be moved (5-56). Required unless squareFeet is provided; you must supply at least one of squareFeet or linearFeet.

loadFlightsOfStairs.description: Flights of stairs at the loading location (0-20)

squareFeet.description: The square feet of the goods to be moved (1-4000). Required unless linearFeet is provided; you must supply at least one of squareFeet or linearFeet.

unloadFlightsOfStairs.description: Flights of stairs at the unloading location (0-20)

name: get_move_size_recommendation
